name: MIME to MAPI Conversion
description: Windows MDM settings in the MIME to MAPI Conversion category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Change the limit for the number of characters in Friendly Name (User)
properties.description: By default, the limit is 1000 characters for Friendly Name when an e-mail message is converted from MIME to MAPI. The number can be set to any positive integer. This helps prevent scenarios in which Outlook hangs while attempting conversion.

properties.name: Change the limit for the number of MIME body parts (User)
properties.description: By default, the limit is 250 for the number of MIME body parts when an e-mail message is converted from MIME to MAPI. The number can be set to any positive integer. This helps prevent scenarios in which Outlook hangs while attempting conversion.

properties.name: Change the limit for the number of MIME headers (User)
properties.description: By default, the limit is 20000 for the number of MIME headers when an e-mail message is converted from MIME to MAPI. The number can be set to any positive integer. This helps prevent scenarios in which Outlook hangs while attempting conversion.

properties.name: Change the limit for the number of nested embedded messages (User)
properties.description: By default, the limit is 50 embedded messages when an e-mail message is converted from MIME to MAPI. The number can be set to any positive integer. This helps prevent scenarios in which Outlook hangs while attempting conversion.

properties.name: Change the limit for the number of recipients (User)
properties.description: By default, the limit is 12288 recipients included for an e-mail message when the message is converted from MIME to MAPI. The number can be set to any positive integer. This helps prevent scenarios in which Outlook hangs while attempting conversion.
